findings: Stage 12 repair: both nonverbal speaker-attribution checks contain demonstrations whose turn_id does not match replay_text. In nc-01, p01-t01 is only 'Hello!' but the demonstration replays 'Hello! I'm Taro. Are you Ninereeds?'; in nc-02, p03-t01 is 'Who are you?' but the demonstration replays 'Are you Taro?'. Rebuild each worked demonstration from an exact accepted story turn and bind the complete demonstrated option pair plus the observable select/show-correct action sequence, so a zero-convention learner can infer the machine task before the scored replay.

Stage 13 repair: TRAIN_LONGER has a frozen order and stop rule but no deterministic release predicate or precedence relative to TRAIN_MORE, PRESENT_AGAIN, and REPLAY_LESSON. Add a mechanically evaluable trigger, single-use/accounting state, and action precedence; otherwise the controller cannot determine whether or when this branch runs.

Stage 13 repair: REPLAY_LESSON does not define how replay outcomes update or replace first-execution gate, mixed, story, comprehension, recap, and overall-mastery records. Freeze the reset/aggregation rule and the post-replay mastery and FINISH disposition so identical traces cannot produce different terminal decisions.
